tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// pratāyitāgamas+yabīṇanāmashrīsarbadurgatiparishodhanas+yātan+t+radawadatobas+t+rarakhāshrītasabasādhanatsapāṇ+yādānaṃprakāshakaraṣ+yawar+ṇābidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge yid ches lung gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs// oṃ swasti sid+dhi ran+tu/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dbyings// dbyings las ma g.yos rnam par snang ba'i gzugs// gzugs med gzugs su gtogs pa thams cad rig /rig pa'i rgyal po bla mar bcas la 'dud// kun mkhyen chos kyi chu gter chen po las// legs par bab pa'i gsang chen sngags kyi klung*// ngan 'gro gsum po rgyu dang bcas pa'i dri// sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs la 'di rmad byung*// rgyud des dngos su bstan pa'i yi dam lha// ras bris la brten bsnyen dang sgrub pa yi// lag len gsal ba'i yi ge rgya bod kyi// yid ches lung gi rgyud mangs cung zad 'khrol// 'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i bris sku sgrub pa'i cho ga rgyud 'grel rnams las 'byung ba'i snying po bsdus te brjod pa la bzhi/ bris sku bri ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i cho ga dang de'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ rgyud las/ ras la bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa de bzhin du bris la zhes sogs nas/ de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po nyid thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa nyid bri'o zhes bya ba'i bar gyis bri bar bstan te/ de yang tshes grangs bzang por ras 'dul byas pa'i gzhi la lha bzo pa gso sbyong la gnas pas/ gtso bo seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ khro bo gnyis la nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ de'i g.yas su ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar po phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/

g.yon du shākya thub pa ser po phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ gsum ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can no// de dag gi 'og gi g.yas su kun du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkar po phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yon na 'bras bu a ru ra bsnams pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing na bza' chos gos ngur smrig rnam gsum gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi 'og gi phyogs su rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyi bor rta mgo ljang gus brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dku la sgreng ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i 'og gi phyogs su 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngo nag shin tu khros pa phyag gnyis kyis rang gi snying gar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gnyis ka'ang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de gnyis kyi bar du spyan ma dkar mo g.yas pa'i spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yon gdan la brten cing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa'o// de dag gi 'og tu pad+ma'i rdzing bu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba'i nang du chu srin dang*/ nya dang*/ rus sbal dang*/ sbal pa dkar po dang*/ nya khar ba dang*/ dung dang*/ pir la sogs pa'i srog chags du ma dang*/ chu las skyes pa'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs cher rgyas pa la bung ba myos pa rnams kyis 'phur lding bsgyur zhing dbyangs snyan par 'byin pa/ gzhan yang bdug pa dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ bshos dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba dang bcas pa bri'o// de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po nyid thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa bri'o// gnyis pa rab gnas ni/ rgyud las/ de nas ri mo'i gzugs de mngon par mchod de zhes pa nas/ de nas gzugs de byin brlabs te/ zhes bya ba'i bar gyis bstan/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// ci bdog pas ni mchod par bya// zhes pas mchod pa bstan te rgya gzhung rnams nas rab gnas rgyas par gsungs shing*/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel las/ bris zin pa'i rjes de nas/ yo byad tshogs par byas te rab gnas kyi cho ga tshang bar byas la/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ ri mo'i sku gzugs de la dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug nas mchod pa ci 'byor pas mchod de/ oṃ tsak+ṣu zhes sogs kyi bdag nyid kyis spyan dbye bar bya zhing mchod bstod rdzogs par byas la/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa sogs nas/ de nas sku gzugs de'i thugs kar sngags bkod la rtsa rig dang las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pas mtshan ma zhig mthong na ni zhes sogs ni go sla'o zhes pa'i bar gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas/ bdag gi lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa sgrub pa sogs spyi ltar byas la/

sbyong ba dang khrus nas brtsams te rab gnas spyi ltar las/ khyad par bri ba'i skabs bzhin du dam tshig pa bskyed pa lhag ma rnams spyi 'gro ltar spyan dbye ba dang mchod bstod dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas la/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs par dmigs pa bya ba ni me tog thogs la ngag tu/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams ma zhig gi bar du bdag cag gi rten 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad rab tu gnas par gyur cig dngos grub thams cad stsol cig bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag la dngos grub tu 'gyur na sku gzugs kyi rten 'di las rtags sna tshogs pa mthong bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// de nas sku gzugs de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sngags bkod pa la dmigs te/ rten la gzungs thag btags pa bzung nas rtsa rig dang las sngags kyi bzlas pa ci ltar rigs par bya'o// de nas ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis rgyas par byas mthar mchod bstod bya'o// de ltar byas pas rgyud nas bshad pa'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma rnams mthong na dngos grub nye bar 'gyur la/ ma mthong na ni ring zhig nas dngos grub 'byung bar bshad do// gsum pa sgrub pa bya ba la bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen po'o// dang po ni/ rgyud las/ rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas kyang*// 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis// bdag srung la sogs byas nas ni// bdag gi de nyid bsams nas su// dngos grub mtshan ma byung bar du// 'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug

/ces gsungs/ slob dpon rdo rje go chas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs de mdun du bzhugs pa la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du bsams nas/ dang po rang nyid khams gsum rnam par rgyal bar bsgoms nas bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ bdag dang gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsrung ba byas te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa sogs bya zhing*/ rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang dbyer med par byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal dang*/ lte ba nas lte bar am̐ la sogs pa 'od zer dkar po dang ldan pa'i phreng bas lu gu rgyud du byas te rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag gsum bzlas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs/ kun mkhyen gyis rgyud 'grel las kyang*/ sgrub pa po rtag tu ras bris kyi mdun du mngon sum du 'dug nas kyang*/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ bdag srung la sogs pa'i srung 'khor bsdus pa byas nas kyang*/ bdag gi de nyid lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par dran par byas shing*/ ras bris dmigs yul du bzhag nas phyag rgya ston cing*/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma byung gi bar du'am grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum mam/ yang na 'bum phrag drug tu rtsa rig bzla bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni/ ras bris de nyid gyang logs su bkram pa'i mdun du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma rnams bsham/ rang nyid rten de la zhal phyogs par gnas pa'i rang gi mdun du rdor dril sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsham/ sngon 'gro'i cha gsum btang ba dang mchod pa byin brlabs dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsrung 'khor bsdus pa bsgom pa nas brtsams te bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pa'am dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor gang mos pa cig mchod bstod kyi bar byas/ de nas bzlas pa ni ras bris la rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgya dang bud+dha sogs kyis dbang bskur tsam byas la/

bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun gyi ras bris kyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i dmigs pa tsam mam yang na sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa zhal nas zhal dang lte ba nas lte bar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa gong du lung drangs pa ltar byas te bzlas pa ci 'grub dang thun gyi mjug tu cha gsum btang nas bdag bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas sngags 'bum phrag gsum mam drug la sogs pa bzlas pa ni bsnyen pa'o// gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa la/ de ltar bsnyen pa sngon du song ba des/ rgyud las/ de las dben pa'i gnas su ni// brgyad brgya nyid du tshang bar bya// sngags ni 'khral 'khrul med par bzlas// zhes dang*/ rdo rje go cha'i 'grel pa las/ bde bar gshegs pa sras dang 'khor du bcas pa'i snying po rnams gnas shin tu dben par dri dang ba'i rnam lnga la sogs pas sa gzhi legs par byugs la/ me tog bkram ste mchod pa la sogs pa byas pas lha re re la brgya rtsa brgyad du sngags zur ma nyams par bzla ba ni nye ba'i sgrub pa'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni bsham tshul sogs gong gi bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin du/ bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pa'am/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gang rung bsgoms nas bzlas pa'i mjug gi mchod bstod kyi bar bsnyen pa'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin byas/ de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas bzhag go /mdun gyi ras bris yak+ṣa sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi gnas su sogs nas bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba dang bcas par gyur zhes pa'i bar/ gong ras bris bri ba'i skabs bzhin brjod/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad gtso 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sogs dang*/ yon chab/ khrus chab/ gdan 'bul/ dri dang me tog sogs kyis mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug byas/ oṃ bhṛ ta sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bud+dha sogs kyis dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs re re sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs sh+lau ka gcig gam yang na chos dbyings ye shes sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod pa bsdus pa tsam byas/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni bris sku la gzungs thag btags pa nas bzung ste rtsa rig bzla bar bshad de/ de yang kun mkhyen gyis gzhan phan rtsod spong las/ gong gi 'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug ces pa dang*/ skabs 'dir brgyad brgya nyid du tshang bar bya// zhes pa dang*/ 'og gi mtshan gcig thog thag bzla bar bya// zhes pa rnams rtsa rig yin par dgag gzhag gi shugs las bstan pa dang*/ rtsa rig ni kun rig gi lha thams cad kyi rtsa sngags yin par grub pa'i tshul gyis thams cad la khyab par bstan pa yin no// grangs ni/ gong du drangs pa ltar lha re re la brgya rtsa brgyad re bzla ba'am/ yang na rgyud kyi lung drangs pa bzhin thun mong du sngags brgyad brgyar tshang bar gsungs kyang grub na 'di'ang zhag grangs ci rigs par byung na legs par sems/ gang ltar yang sems rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bzla ba ni shin tu gnad che'o// thun bsdu ba'i tshe bris sku la mchod bstod gong ltar dang bstod pa rgyas pa la spro na chos dbyings ye shes sogs dang me long ye shes sogs dang so sor kun rtog sogs dang grwa yi phyogs sogs dang*/ thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i sogs dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs dang*/ stobs po che la drag shul sogs dang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs dang*/

bstod par 'os pa sogs sh+lau ka re res bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs kyis bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya'o// skabs 'dir cha gsum btang*/ de nas bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pa ltar na bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba rnams byas nas spyod lam la 'jug bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa rgyas par ltar na/ rang mar me gcig las gnyis chad ltar gtso bo las bye nas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nang du bzhugs par bsams te rang nyid khang pa'i phyi rol du spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// de nas thun gnyis pa dang gsum pa la rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas khang pa'i nang du zhugs la/ sngar bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad du bsgoms nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yud tsam gyis dran par byas la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bzlas pa cung zad byas nas/ yig brgyas brtan par bya ba dang nyer spyod dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod bstod dkyus ltar byas la/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams byin brlabs byas nas bzhag de nas ras bris yak+ṣas bsang ba nas/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya ba'i bar snga ma ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug sdud yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ dam rgya rtsa rig lan gsum bzla ba dang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus te/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du sems yun ring du mnyam par bzhag go /de las langs nas dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngo ba dang spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor bya ba rnams ni nye ba'i sgrub pa'o// gsum pa sgrub pa ni/

rgyud las/ de nas bzlas pa'i mjug tu ni// dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams la// mchod pa rgya chen byas nas kyang*// mtshan gcig thog thag bzlas par bya// zhes dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje go chas/ nye ba'i sgrub pa rdzogs pa dang*/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyis bskyed de/ yang dag par bsams nas mchod pa rgya chen po dang gtor ma la sogs pa sngar gsungs pa bzhin du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa rnams kyi nye ba'i snying po grangs ci rigs par nyi ma rgas nas skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du bzlas par bya ste/ de ni sgrub pa'o zhes dang*/ yang snang ba'i rgyan zhes pa kun snying gis mdzad zer ba zhig las kyang bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i mjug tu dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du bsams la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang ldan pas/ mtshan gcig thog thag bzlas brjod byas nas zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen gyis gzhan phan rtsod spong las kyang dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams la zhes pa'i don/ sngar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dir sgrub pa'i skabs su bdag bskyed la bsgom par dngos su gsungs pas zhes sogs dang*/ yang de nyid kyi rgyud 'grel las kyang*/ de nas bzlas pa'i mjug tu ni/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du bsams la zhes pa'am/ yang na ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor snga ma rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhin du bsams la ras bris la/ mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas kyang zhes gsungs pa'i don ni gong du bshad pa'i sngags kyi grangs song bar bzlas pa'i rjes su tshes bco lnga la bab pa'i dgongs mo nas brtsams te ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor kho na'am/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis ka bya ba 'dam ga can du gsungs pa las 'di phyi ma ltar bya ba legs pas/ sngar gyi bris sku'i mdun du gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor zhal shar du phyogs par bkram pa'i mthar mchod gtor phyag len ltar bsham mo// khyad par sang gi dus su dgongs pa'i ro mchog gi zhal zas dkar gsum mngar gsum dang shing thog la sogs pa'i kha zas gtsang ma rnams kyis rin po che'i snod khengs par bkang ba'ang bzhag go

/de nas nyi ma rgas ka nas brtsams te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs nas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa nas brtsams te/ skabs 'dir bdag gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nges pa can du sngon du 'gro bar byas nas dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la thim pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas bdag 'jug len na bum pa dkyus bzhin bsgrub/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod cha gsum gtor ma btang ba bcas dkyus bzhin bya/ spro na bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba nas mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs kyi bar grub zin pa dang*/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung ste mdun gyi bris sku snga ma bzhin du bskyed de/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ mchod pa nyer lnga dang*/ sgeg sogs brgyad dang*/ rin chen bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga rnams rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na sngags mchod tsam byas la/ gong du smras pa ltar chos dbyings ye shes sogs sh+lau ka re res bstod do// de nas gzungs thag nas bzung ste skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du rtsa rig bzlas pa ni sgrub pa'o// bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rgyud las/ ci ste gtso bo'am de yi sras// yang na lha rnams mthong gyur na// bsod nams snod la ci dga' bar// dngos grub mchog gi gsol bar bya// lha ni dngos grub 'bras bu ni// de la rtag tu dgyes nas stsol// phyag 'tshal dngos grub la sogs blang*// dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la// skal ba re re phul nas ni// de nas rtag tu bdag spyod cing*// med na mkhas pa rang nyid kyis// blangs nas bdag nyid spyad par bya// zhes gsungs/ rdo rje go chas/ sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i 'og tu mchod pa rgya chen po byas te/ mi 'gyur ba yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bla na med pa'i dbang po lnga'i yul gyi rang bzhin/

dpal ldan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i rab kyi mtha' las byung ba'i rang rig pa'i phung po chen po spro zhing rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba chen po lnga'i ro'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ rlabs stong gis yang nas yang du dbang bskur zhing rang dang gzhan gyi rnam pa'i cha mtha' dag nub par gyur pa de ni mchog gi dga' ba'i sdong po las byung ba'i rang rig pa myu gu dpal rje btsun ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i ngo bo ste/ de ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bde ba chen po dang*/ chos dang sprul pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste sku bzhi'i rten du gyur pa rnam par snang mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bo yin zhing 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi bdag nyid do// ci ste gtso'am de yi sras zhes sogs ni de ltar bsgoms pa'i bde bar gshegs pa nyid dam/ de'i sras bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'am khro bo'i lha'i gzugs la sogs pas/ bsod nams kyi snod sgrub pa po'i drung du mthong bar byon te/ de la bdag gis dga' ba chen pos mchod pa la sogs pa byas la/ rang ji ltar 'dod pa ltar phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i dngos grub gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de la dad pa dang dam tshig tu 'brel pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis dgyes bzhin du dngos grub kyi 'bras bu stsol ba ste/ de la dngos grub ni 'dir gnyis te/ gcig ni dmigs pa'i rig byar ma gyur pa byin gyis brlabs pa chen po dang ldan pa'o// gcig ni dmigs pa'i rig byar gyur pa rdzas la sogs pa'i gzugs su 'ongs te/ de la 'dir ni rdzas la sogs pa 'ong ba la dgongs nas bla ma dkon mchog la phul ba sogs gsungs te/ de yang bdud rtsi'am mi gtsang ba'am bza' ba'i rnam pa la sogs pa rgyu dang rkyen med par snang bar gyur na zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// brtag pa snang ba'i rgyan las ci ste gtso bo'am/

byang chub sems dpa' dang 'jig rten pa mthong ba las/ dngos grub rab 'bring gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ phyag 'tshal nas dngos grub blang bar bya'o zhes dang kun mkhyen gyis phyag 'tshal dngos grub la sogs blang zhes sogs te go sla'o zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don ni/ de ltar sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i rjes thogs skya rengs shar ba nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la sngar gyi ro mchog gi zhal zas dang bcas pa'i mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod gong ltar byas pa'i mthar mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar rtse gcig tu mi 'gyur ba yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba spros bral de kho na nyid kyi ngang du ma yengs par mnyam par bzhag pas/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i rgyal ba'am rgyal ba'i sras sam/ 'jig rten pa la sogs pa'i rnam par dngos sam nyams kyi snang bar mthong bar gyur pa'am/ gal te dngos su mthong bar ma gyur na'ang gsang sngags pa ni rnam pa thams cad du thar pa ste 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi rnam pa'am mos pa lam du byed pa yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar dmigs la/ lag pa thal mo sbyar la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod la skabs 'dir sngar bshams pa'i ro mchog gi zhal zas bde bar gshegs pas mchod pa'i lhag ma dngos grub kyi tshul du bltas/ rang nyid kyis tshim par longs spyad par byas nas/ dngos grub thob sems kyi dmigs pa gsal ba sogs shin tu 'thad par sems so// de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ gang yang bdag blo sogs kyis bzod par gsol ba dang*/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa zhes sogs kyis sku gzugs kyi rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba rnams bya ba ste/

de dag ni sgrub pa chen po'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog sogs bkra shis rgyas pa'i bar bya'o// bzhi pa ni de ltar bsgrubs pa'i phan yon gyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ rgyud las/ bskal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur// ci ste dngos grub ma gyur na'ang*// las rnams thams cad nus par 'gyur// gnod sbyin skar ma'i gdong la sogs// chad pas bcad cing bka' tsam gyis// zhi ba la sogs las kun ni// bran bzhin thams cad byed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ rgyud 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po gsum las rnal 'byor pa'i tshe bsring ba'i cho ga gsungs te/ de la 'og ma gnyis ni tshe rgyas pa kho na gtso bor bsgrub pa yin la/ 'di ni tshe dang yang dag pa'i byang chub gnyi ga sgrub pa'i thabs su gsungs te/ de bsgrubs pa las 'bras bu ci zhig 'ong na/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dgod par bya ba'i phyir bskal pa grangs med pa la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod par 'gro ba'i don byed cing gnas par 'gyur ba sogs dang*/ gal te de ltar bshad pa'i dngos grub grub par ma gyur na'ang zhi ba la sogs pa'i phrin las bzhi 'grub pa dang*/ shin tu gdul bar dka' ba gnod sbyin skar ma gdong la sogs pa yang bdag gi ming thos pa tsam gyis mdun du 'ongs te/ ji ltar bsgo ba'i las thams cad bran bzhin du byed pa la sogs par 'gyur ba ni nges par gdon mi za ba nyid do// smras pa/ bskal bzang rgyal ba dges pa'i zhal sgo nas// legs par gdams pa'i snying po gsang ba'i sngags// dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi don// dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga 'di rmad byung*// de nyid 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can 'dir// byon pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyis bkral ba las// gces pa'i me tog gcig tu bsdus pa'i phon// don gnyer mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du brin// rnam dkar dge ba'i mtho ris rgyun gtsang gis// lam gsum 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma'i tshogs// rnam par sbyangs nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi// snye ma phun tshogs g.yur du za bar shog

/de ltar dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge yid ches lung gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis rnam par 'byor pa'i bla ma puṇ+ye shwa ra'i gsung mchid dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i sor rtses nye bar bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i skyes chen mang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mar bsnyen cing gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i sgro btags mkhan tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rgyud dang rje btsun rin po che'i gzhan phan 'od zer gzhir bzung nas mkhan grub gong ma'i legs bshad kyis rnam par spros te lag tu blang bde ba'i mtshams sbyor cung zad dang bcas te rnga chen gyi gnam lo shar bar sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi shugs 'byung tshe ldan sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga'i zur rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// zla gzhon 'od khyab kha ba'i rdul brtsegs bzhin// gang sku dran tsam ngan 'gro'i gdung ba bcil// bla ma rnam par snang byed la btud de// tshe ldan sdig pa sbyong tshul rnam gsal bgyi// 'dir ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i sgo bdun las/ phyir bzlog gi sgo nas gson po'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga thams cad gzhan phan mtha' yas ji lta ba bzhin las/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod pa la/ sbyor ba'i skabs su shog bu la sdig pa'i sa bon kam̐ yig nag po bsgrub bya'i ming yig dang bcas pa bris pa bzhag dngos gzhi la bdag gi rnal 'byor nas brtsams te bdag 'jug bzlas pa'i bar grub nas/

bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa la sbyong ba nas brtsams te ming byang bsregs pa'i bar bya ba yin gyi/ rten bskyed pa dang dgug gzhug sdig pa dral ba rnams ni 'dir mi dgos pas/ de'ang mdun du sbyong chas til ming byang sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bshams la gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ las kyi rdo rjes bsgrub bya la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ rang gis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba bigh+nāṃ sogs lan gsum gyis zhi bas sbyang*/ de bzhin du ting lo dang chang bus bskor zhing*/ rdo rje gsor la oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ deng 'dir tshe dang ldan pa che ge mo zhes bya ba la bar du gcod cing sdig pa sbyong ba la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan sogs brjod pas zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ khro bo spyan drangs nas bden pa bdar ba'i mthar spel tshig kha bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra bar brjod pa ni drag po'i sbyong ba'o// de bzhin du til sbyong yang dkyus bzhin bya/ de nas 'dir sngags bzlas nas bye mas brab pa gson po la mi mdzad ces 'ga' zhig tu 'byung yang*/ 'di man chad phyir bzlog gi dngos gzhi yin pas ma chad par byed pa legs te/ rgyud las/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs// rang gi ming brjod sngags btab nas// bzlas pa byas te gtor nas kyang*// rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung dor// de ltar byas na sdig chen yang*// ngan song las ni thar 'gyur zhes// bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs// zhes dang*/ gtsug dgu las kyang*/ yungs kar me tog dang ldan pas/ gsang sngags bzla zhing brdeg par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na bye ma'am yungs kar la rtsa rig la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa bstims la/ tshe dang ldan pa de'i rgyud kyi sdig pa sbyong ba'i phyir brdeg par bsams la/

oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces sogs brdeg sngags rnams dkyus ltar brjod cing brab la tshe dang ldan pa'i sdig pa dag par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas rnam rgyal bum pas dkyil 'khor la me long bstan par/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis bzang khrus byas pa'i chu bum par blugs te/ des bsgrub bya'i kha dang gdong dang yan lag rnams bkru zhing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna la sogs pa'i dri ma drug dag nas sbyin pa sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi yon tan dang ldan par bsams la/ tshigs bcad dang rtsa rig spel te brjod mthar/ tshe dang ldan pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis sogs brjod/ tshig 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// de bzhin du nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa dag ste/ 'dod chags med pa la sogs pa'i dge ba gsum dang ldan par bsams la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs brjod/ yang rgyu 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas byung ba'i nyon mongs dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad dag nas/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsams la/ sa 'di dug gi sogs brjod/ de ltar sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig snyam pas/ bum chus gtor zhing*/ me tog gi char dbab pa dang bcas pas/ gang la ser sna sogs kyi shis pa brjod do// de nas bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba dang lus dbul ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas/ de'ang gzhung gi tshig tshe 'das zhes pa'i tshab tu tshe ldan zhes par bsgyur te/ tshig 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod ces brjod la/

spro na/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sogs dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces sogs brjod cing phyag 'tshal du gzhug pa'i phyag len kyang mchis/ gang ltar yang*/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs kyis skyabs su 'gro zhing lus 'bul lo// zhar byung ming byang bsreg pa ni dbang bskur ba'i rjes sam/ dbang gi gong 'dir bsreg pa gnyis gang bder bya ste/ dbang bskur ba'i rjes su byed na/ skabs 'dir dbang bskur la/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes pa'i rjes su ming byang bsreg pa yin la skabs 'dir byed na dpal 'bar me sbar ba thogs te/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros bral du shes par byas te/ de'i ngang nas slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ khyed rang gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ sgo gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin/ ba spu'i bu ga dang dbang po'i sgo rnams nas/ kaṃ yig nag po dang dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pas nag nyil gyis thon/ mdun gyi sdig pa'i sa bon kam̐ yig nag po de nyid la thim par mos pa mdzod/ kam̐ yig de nyid 'khrul ngor snang ba khyed rang gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyi ngo bo bsreg cing sbyong du rung ba dpe bud shing dang chos mtshungs pa de nyid/ slob dpon gyis chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas sbyong byed me dang chos mtshungs su snang ba des/ kam̐ yig de nyid bsregs shing sbyangs pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes kyi snang ba chen po gcig tu 'bar bar mos pa mdzod ces dang*/

stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe ldan sgrib pa'i zhes sogs/ rtsa rig zlo gin bsregs la dmigs med kyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag go /de nas dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur la/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol /zhes dang*/ de rnams kyis ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa phyir bzlog gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba dang*/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba dang bcas pa thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod ces sam/ gal te dbang bskur mi byed par phyir bzlog dang byang sreg tsam byed na/ phyir bzlog gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i rim pa 'bul grub pa yin pas dga' spro rgya chen po mdzod/ ces dang bsod nams gzhan don du bsngos la/ bsgrub bya rang gnas su btang nas rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// gzhan phan mtha' yas shugs 'byung tshe ldan gyi// sdig sbyong cho ga rnam gsal zur rgyan 'di// bskrun pa'i dge bas sems can ma lus pa// sdug bsngal de rgyu bcas las grol gyur cig /ces kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi shugs 'byung tshe ldan sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga'i zur rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa dkar dbu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu mgyogs par bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// kun rig sbyin sreg skabs kyi gsal byed gsar bu 'jug bde ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma rnam par snang mdzad dag /tha dad min la phyag 'tshal nas// kun rig sbyin sreg cho ga yi// gsal byed gsar bu 'jug bde 'dri// de'ang rje ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i ngan song sbyong ba'i sbyin sreg gi gong mtha' rnams mi gsal ba med kyang*/ lha bskyed skabs su rtsa ba'i lha rnams bum bskyed ltar dang*/

mgron thabs dang 'khor yug gi lha rnams de'i rigs 'gros sbyar te zhal phyag gsal gdab/ ces gsungs pa de la 'ga' zhig gis lha dgod gzhi la'ang snam bu'i tha snyad btags pa sogs ma 'grel ba dang*/ 'don brjod ngag mi mnyam pa mang du snang ba dang*/ gzhung der bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i skabs nas cung zad bsdus ches pa rnams su/ gsar bu rnams kyis 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir ngag 'don du bstar ba la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs nas rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po nas pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar bum pa'i nang bzhin brjod/ de'i phyi rol gyi rim pa'i phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug gi steng du shar du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mthong ba don yod nas sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi rim pa'i phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug gi steng du shar du 'phags pa dga' bo nas tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rim pa de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi dang phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bcu gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du gdung ba sel ba nas bsnams shing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rim pa de nyid kyi phyi'i phyogs bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis rgyab rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re ste bcu drug gi steng du shar du khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang*/ de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lhor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'dul nas sku mdog ma nges pa dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa/

de'i phyi rol gyi rim pa'i gdan rnams kyi steng du tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu nas bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba zhes pa'i bar brjod pas gsal gdab/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs kyis dbang bskur ro// de nas mchod pa rnams/ bsang sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas brtsams te// 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi// zhes pas bstod pa'i bar dkyil chog mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin nam bsdu na sngags mchod tsam dang*/ bstod pa bsdus pa rjes chog ltar bya'o// de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba na/ gtso bo la yam shing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig gam bskyed sngags gang rung tshar re la yam shing re bgrangs pa'i brgya rtsa brgyad song ba'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du mar brgya dang brgyad/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams la brgya dang brgyad song ba'i mthar spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul/ sbyong rgyal la yam shing*/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐ nyer gcig gi grangs mnyam du phul mthar/ bcom ldan 'das sbyong ba'i rgyal pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sogs gong ltar bya/ mar dang bsreg rdzas gnyis po la'ang 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gsum la yam shing*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid aḥlan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha lan gsum gyi grangs mnyam du phul mthar/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal mchog rin chen/ shākya rigs dbang*/ me tog cher rgyas te de bzhin gshegs pa gsum gyis bdag dang sems can sogs dang*/ mar dang bsreg rdzas gnyis la'ang 'dra/ de bzhin du man chad rnams la bzhi tshan du byas na stabs bde bas/ yum bzhi la yam shing*/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni sogs gsum/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī sogs gsum/

oṃ badz+ra paṇ+ḍa re sogs gsum/ oṃ badz+ra tā re sogs gsum gyi grangs mnyam du phul mthar/ spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma ste yum bzhis kyang bdag dang sogs dang*/ mar dang bsreg rdzas gnyis la'ang 'dra/ sems dpa' rnams la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ sogs nas/ sā dhu dhu gsum gsum song ba'i mthar/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje legs pa ste shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag dang sogs man chad 'dra'o// oṃ badz+ra rat+na sogs gsum gsum/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje gzi brjid/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje bzhad pa ste lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag dang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sogs gsum gsum/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje rgyu/ rdo rje smra ba ste nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag dang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra karma sogs gsum gsum/ rdo rje las/ rdo rje srung ba/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur te byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag dang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya sogs gsum gsum/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma ste nang gi lha mo bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe sogs gsum gsum/ bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma ste phyi'i lha mo bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha sogs gsum gsum/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog rdo rje 'bebs pa ste sgo ba bzhis kyang bdag dang sogs 'dra/ 'di man gyi mgron thabs pa'i sde tshan rnams la rtsa rig gsum re dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mthong ba don yod nas kun tu bzang po ste sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rtsa rig gsum dang 'phags pa dga' bo nas 'od srungs te nyan thos chen po bcu drug gis kyang bdag dang sogs 'dra/

rtsa rig gsum dang gdung ba sel ba snang ba brtsegs pa nas yid myur ba ste rang rgyal bcu gnyis kyis bdag dang sogs 'dra/ rtsa rig gsum dang khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngag pa bzhi/ bran bzhi ste sgo ba bcu drug gis kyang sogs 'dra/ phyi'i 'khor yug pa rnams la rtsa rig gsum dang phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ 'jigs byed dgu nas 'jig rten pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du mar dang bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams la'ang 'dra'o// de nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa gsol ba gdab pa 'di ma chad pa gal che ste lha thams cad la gsol gdab 'di las med pa'i phyir ro// de nas til brgya re dang rtsa rig brgya re grangs mnyam du song mthar/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs brjod cing ci mang bsags nas mthar/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs nas/ 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi zhes pa'i bar kun rig rjes chog ltar ro// slar yang yam shing sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs bdun bdun gyis phul mthar/ bdag gi sdig pa sogs spel tshig dang*/ mar dang bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams la'ang des 'gre/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo 'jig rten gsum las sogs phrin las gong bzhin bcol lo// gzhan rnams dkyus su gsal lo// de ltar kun rig sbyin sreg yi ge'i skabs kyi gsal byed gsar bu 'jug bde ces bya ba 'di ni/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
